scope: R171 maximal-combination bound: is any reachable combination below 10 s
method: take every region that has an identified improvement path, apply each one at the best value this host has ever demonstrated or at a fully optimistic halving, and add them all at once. Anything left over gets no saving at all.

fa_kernel.best_case: the host best measured GEMM efficiency, 96.9 TFLOPS per card

four_linears.best_case: all at their measured standalone rates
four_linears.caveat: 1.665 s of this is the FP32 guard pair and needs a user precision decision

usp_pre_post.caveat: NO mechanism identified in twenty rounds of profiling

attention_residual.caveat: NO mechanism identified in twenty rounds of profiling

safety_audit.why: R168 a cheaper implementation regressed the step by 0.75 s and R170 showed deferral needs 24.44 GiB against 20.36 GiB of headroom, so this is irreducible under the current contract

verdict: 10 s is NOT reachable by any combination of identified improvements
argument: adding every identified saving at once takes 17.902 s down to 10.2 s
that is still above the 10 s target
and it assumes two halvings, for USP and for the attention residual, that have no identified mechanism at all
without those two, the best combination is about 11.42 s
what_would_be_needed: a kernel faster than the best GEMM efficiency this host has ever demonstrated, or
a mechanism for the 1.36 s attention residual and the 1.087 s USP overhead, neither of which exists today, or
relaxing the constraint that all 155 checks run inside every measured step, which alone is worth 2.87 s
consequence: the target cannot be met by engine work; it needs a decision at the target or constraint level
